CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION avg_days_to_first_reply(p_category VARCHAR, p_min_views INT)
RETURNS NUMERIC
LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $$
BEGIN
  RETURN (
    SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(days_to_reply), 2), 0.00)
    FROM (
      SELECT 
        t.thread_id,
        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (MIN(r.replied_at) - t.created_at)) / 86400.0 AS days_to_reply
      FROM threads t
      INNER JOIN replies r ON t.thread_id = r.thread_id
      WHERE t.category = p_category
        AND COALESCE(t.view_count, 0) >= p_min_views
        AND r.member_id != t.thread_creator_id
      GROUP BY t.thread_id, t.created_at
    ) first_replies
  );
END;
$$;

SELECT avg_days_to_first_reply('General Discussion', 50) AS result;

INSERT INTO collections_queue (purchase_id, customer_id, installment_number, due_date, amount_due, escalation_date, priority_tier)
SELECT 
  i.purchase_id,
  i.customer_id,
  i.installment_number,
  i.due_date,
  i.amount_due,
  DATE '2024-06-15' AS escalation_date,
  CASE 
    WHEN i.amount_due >= 500 THEN 'high'
    ELSE 'standard'
  END AS priority_tier
FROM installments i
WHERE i.payment_status = 'missed'
  AND i.due_date < DATE '2024-06-15' - INTERVAL '30 days'
  AND i.purchase_id IN (
    SELECT purchase_id
    FROM installments
    WHERE payment_status = 'missed'
    GROUP BY purchase_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
  );

SELECT * FROM collections_queue ORDER BY queue_id;

scenario: a short video platform tracking watch time and completion rates
answer_key:
WITH combined AS (
  SELECT viewer_id, viewer_name, status_date, 'active' AS status
  FROM active_viewers
  WHERE status_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT viewer_id, viewer_name, status_date, 'inactive' AS status
  FROM inactive_viewers
  WHERE status_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    viewer_id,
    viewer_name,
    status,
    status_date,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY viewer_id ORDER BY status_date) -
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY viewer_id, status ORDER BY status_date) AS grp
  FROM combined
)
SELECT
  viewer_id,
  STRING_TO_ARRAY(MAX(viewer_name), '')[1] AS first_name,
  status,
  MIN(status_date) AS start_date,
  MAX(status_date) AS end_date
FROM ranked
GROUP BY viewer_id, status, grp

answer_key: WITH cleaned AS (SELECT installment_id, INITCAP(TRIM(REPLACE(SPLIT_PART(status_raw, '|', 1), '  ', ' '))) AS status_label, created_at, tags FROM installments WHERE status_raw LIKE '%|%' AND NULLIF(TRIM(SPLIT_PART(status_raw, '|', 1)), '') IS NOT NULL), grouped AS (SELECT installment_id, status_label, created_at, tags, installment_id - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status_label ORDER BY installment_id) AS grp FROM cleaned) SELECT status_label, MIN(installment_id) AS start_id, MAX(installment_id) AS end_id, TO_CHAR((ARRAY_AGG(created_at ORDER BY installment_id))[1], 'FMMonth') AS start_month, COUNT(DISTINCT tags[1]) AS unique_tags_count, CASE WHEN MOD(COUNT(*)::NUMERIC, 2) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS risk_flag FROM grouped GROUP BY status_label, grp ORDER BY start_id;

scenario: an observability platform tracking alert acknowledge time and MTTR
answer_key:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', triggered_at)::DATE AS month,
    INITCAP(TRIM(category)) AS category,
    SUM(COALESCE(time_to_ack_minutes::NUMERIC, 0)) AS total_ack_minutes
  FROM alerts
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
  month,
  category,
  total_ack_minutes,
  ROUND(100.0 * total_ack_minutes / NULLIF(SUM(total_ack_minutes) OVER (PARTITION BY month), 0), 1) AS share_of_month_pct,
  total_ack_minutes - LAG(total_ack_minutes) OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY month) AS mom_change
FROM monthly
ORDER BY month, category;

scenario: a food delivery service tracking order completion and delivery time
answer_key:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date::date)::date AS month_period,
    COUNT(*) AS completed_orders
  FROM delivery_orders
  WHERE LOWER(TRIM(order_status)) = 'completed'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  c.month_period,
  c.completed_orders,
  p.completed_orders AS prev_year_orders,
  c.completed_orders - p.completed_orders AS yoy_change,
  ROUND(100.0 * (c.completed_orders - p.completed_orders) / NULLIF(p.completed_orders, 0), 1) AS yoy_pct
FROM monthly c
LEFT JOIN monthly p ON c.month_period = p.month_period - INTERVAL '1 year'
ORDER BY c.month_period;
